summary: Northern Oil & Gas filed an 8-K disclosing a resale prospectus supplement registering up to 3,689,413 shares of common stock issued to the seller in the Parallax Acquisition. The filing is a routine post-closing registration obligation under a registration rights agreement, not a new M&A event. No price, premium, or board recommendation is provided. The shares were issued in a prior asset purchase. This is a standard shelf takedown for an existing stockholder resale. No special-situation catalyst; the acquisition itself was previously disclosed.
